audit.why: Nami wins levels 1-5 and late (2+ items), contested only at 6 where Wish's global heal can undo an all-in — matches Soraka having no early lockdown but a game-altering global ultimate.
Spikes correctly identify level 2 (Bubble punishes Starcall self-damage), level 6 (Wish coinflip), first item (E burst outpaces her heal-per-second), late (R-to-E kill speed beats her top-off).
